description: GPA says a gathering of around 250 expatriate workers was recent as of 7 March but gives no occurrence date; February-versus-March onset cannot be resolved from current story.
required_followup: Find dated contemporary coverage or direct reporting identifying the assembly date; do not use publication date as event date.

description: The expatriate-workers gathering concerned unpaid salaries from a private employer. Article reports PAM complaint processing and administrative action but does not show a clear demand to the Kuwait government or state policy.
required_followup: Locate an account stating what the gathering demanded and whether workers addressed a state authority; keep pending if not found.

description: The worker gathering is reported at around 250 by a secondary article attributing underlying reporting to Arab Times and Al-Qabas; count is approximate and lacks opened independent confirmation.
required_followup: Seek non-syndicated contemporary corroboration with an event-specific simultaneous crowd estimate.

description: No source explicitly reports when the 27 March Irada Square demonstration physically ended or whether it was dispersed.
required_followup: Search for later same-night or retrospective accounts that explicitly state closure/dispersal; otherwise retain unknown end date and response.

description: Opened account of the 27 March demonstration is Reuters-origin and the separate search-only corroborating result is from The New Arab, whose body remains on hold. Independence and further event detail are limited.
required_followup: Search other permitted local/regional sources for a separately written account; do not open the held New Arab body without a new permissible source-level decision.

description: Q018 search results included a 26 March announcement of a planned Irada Square sit-in. Actual occurrence is documented independently by the 27 March reporting; no need to infer execution from the announcement itself.
required_followup: Retain the announcement as pre-event context; no separate follow-up required unless examining organizer/continuity details.

description: A 13 March Al-Jarida report says electricity-ministry employees held five sit-ins during February, but no dates, individual attendance estimates, public-space details, or relation among the five actions are reported. It does not establish a March protest.
required_followup: Carry this retrospective evidence to February revision; seek event-specific dates, simultaneous counts and public-gathering/continuity details if feasible.

description: Bounded open-web search used English and Arabic query windows across early/mid/late March and focused on political demonstration, unpaid wages/migrant workers, Bidoon, labor and a planned student sit-in. It is not a LexisNexis search or exhaustive archive review; no no-event inference follows for sectors/provinces not surfaced.
required_followup: If official completeness is later required, consult licensed newspaper archive and expand Arabic locality/sector searches with verified returned results.
